info.title: Hertwill Public API
info.description:
Public API for Hertwill dropshipping platform. Discover products, manage your import list, and sync products to your store.

## Authentication

**Public endpoints** (product discovery) require no authentication.

**Authenticated endpoints** (import list, sync) require a store-scoped API key:
```
Authorization: Bearer hw_live_...
```

Create API keys via the web dashboard or the `/v1/api-keys` endpoint (requires JWT login).

## Rate Limits

- Public endpoints: 60 requests/minute per IP
- Authenticated endpoints: 300 requests/minute per API key

Rate limit information is included in responses via the `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` headers (draft-8 combined format).

counts.description: Per-store product totals by status bucket (see §4).

products.description: The sync-failed product subset only (not the full catalog). Bounded to document safe response expectations for stores with many failures.

external_id.description: The remote-platform product id (DropshipProduct.external_id). Null before first sync.

error_class.description: Derived failure classification (see §3). Non-null only when status is sync-failed. Never the raw error payload.

last_sync_date.description: Last successful sync. Presence ⇒ status synced.

start_sync_date.description: Sync run started. Set with null last_sync_date ⇒ status syncing.

Product.description: GET /v1/products and /v1/products/search return the search-index subset. The product-data fields (mpn, recommended_retail_price, country_of_origin, weight_g, shipping_weight_g, dimensions_mm, net_content, material, fibre_composition, ships_from_country, packages, multipack_quantity, is_bundle, price_updated_at, inventory_updated_at, battery, ingredients, recommended_age_group, sales_window, dispatch_days, returns, warranty, size_guide, usage_instructions, care_instructions, safety_warnings, documents, languages, image_details) are on the detail and slug endpoints only. GET /v1/products/slug/{slug} omits brand, collections, categories and shipping_regions.

gtin.description: GTIN (EAN/UPC barcode) of a product WITHOUT variations. `null` when unknown, and always `null` for a variable product — its barcodes live on `variations[].gtin`. Returned by every product endpoint; on GET /v1/products and GET /v1/products/search it comes from the search index and is `null` for variable products there too.

price.description: Wholesale Price in EUR (excl. VAT) — the single price charged to merchants. Login-gated: `null` unless the request carries a valid API key (`Authorization: Bearer hw_live_...`). When null, see the response's `meta.pricing` for the reason.

sale_price.description: Optional temporary sale price (EUR, excl. VAT). When set and lower than `price`, it is the effective wholesale price charged. Login-gated like `price` (`null` for keyless callers).

categories.description: The category's path from the top level down to `category` (breadcrumbs). GET /v1/products/{id} only.

sellable_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries this product can be sold to: its price list has a priced lane there and neither the brand nor the product excludes the country. `shipping_regions` is derived from this set. `null` while not computed yet. On list/search it comes from the search index and may lag a brand or price-list edit by up to a day. Filter with `ships_to`.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number: the brand's own product code. Detail and slug endpoints only, like every product-data field below.

recommended_retail_price.description: The brand's recommended retail price in EUR (incl. VAT), from its own shop. Public, unlike the Wholesale Price.

country_of_origin.description: Where the item is manufactured (customs origin), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

weight_g.description: Weight of the item itself, in grams.

shipping_weight_g.description: Packed weight as shipped, in grams.

dimensions_mm.description: Assembled item, in millimetres; `null` when no dimension is known.

net_content.description: Net content (125 ml, 250 g), for unit pricing.

fibre_composition.description: Textile fibre composition, e.g. "95 % cotton, 5 % elastane".

ships_from_country.description: Where the order is physically dispatched from, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. `null` when not recorded.

packages.description: The cartons the item ships in, one entry per carton.

multipack_quantity.description: Identical items in one sellable unit (a 6-pack is 6).

is_bundle.description: Different products sold together as one set (a gift set).

price_updated_at.description: When the Wholesale Price last changed. Not populated yet, `null` today.

inventory_updated_at.description: When the stock last changed. Not populated yet, `null` today.

battery.description: Whether the item contains or comes with a battery (carriers restrict lithium).

ingredients.description: Cosmetics only, the INCI ingredient list.

recommended_age_group.description: Shopify Standard Product Taxonomy age group value, e.g. "3 years or older". `null` while not recorded.

sales_window.description: A seasonal or limited product's sales period; `null` when it sells all year.

dispatch_days.description: Business days from order to dispatch: the product's own value, else its brand's default. `made_to_order` is true when the item is made after the order. `null` when nothing is recorded.

returns.description: The brand's returns; `null` when the product has no known brand.

size_guide.description: A link to the brand's size guide, a size table (rows of cells), or both.

documents.description: Manuals, assembly guides, safety sheets and declarations of conformity.

languages.description: Languages (ISO 639-1, lower case) on the packaging, in the instructions and in the safety information. `null` when none is recorded.

image_details.description: The product's stored images in gallery order (featured first, the order `images` lists them), with pixel size, alt text and the 800 / 1600 px renders.

Returns.description: The published returns policy for this brand (hertwill.com/resources/returns-refunds). `accepted` is false for the brands that take no returns; the merchant handles those returns themselves. `window_days` and `shipping_cost` are `null` then, and also for a brand that runs its own returns (its terms, not Hertwill's).

window_days.description: Days from the order date to return an unused item.

shipping_cost.description: The return label costs what the outbound shipping cost.

size.description: Pixel size of the stored file; `null` until it has been read.

alt.description: Alt text, "<brand> <product name>" plus ", photo N" after the first image.

sizes.description: Renders keyed by the longer side in pixels; `null` for a file not on our image host.

gtin.description: GTIN (EAN/UPC barcode) of this variation; `null` when unknown. Present on the detail and slug endpoints (list/search responses carry no variations).

price.description: Wholesale Price in EUR (excl. VAT) — the single price charged to merchants. Login-gated: `null` unless the request carries a valid API key. See the response's `meta.pricing`.

sale_price.description: Optional temporary sale price (EUR, excl. VAT). Login-gated like `price` (`null` for keyless callers).

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number: the brand's own product code. `null` means as the product.

recommended_retail_price.description: The brand's recommended retail price in EUR (incl. VAT), from its own shop. Public, unlike the Wholesale Price. `null` means as the product.

country_of_origin.description: Where the item is manufactured (customs origin), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. `null` means as the product.

weight_g.description: Weight of the item itself, in grams. `null` means as the product.

shipping_weight_g.description: Packed weight as shipped, in grams. `null` means as the product.

dimensions_mm.description: Assembled variant, in millimetres. `null` means as the product; an inner `null` means that axis is as the product.

net_content.description: Net content (125 ml, 250 g), for unit pricing. `null` means as the product.

material.description: Primary material (oak, cotton, silicone). `null` means as the product.

fibre_composition.description: Textile fibre composition, e.g. "95 % cotton, 5 % elastane". `null` means as the product.

logo.description: URL of the brand logo image.

cover.description: URL of the brand cover/banner image.

marketing_assets_url.description: Link to the brand's downloadable marketing materials (banners, promo images, product photography) for use in your store.

gpsr.description: EU GPSR (General Product Safety Regulation) responsible-person contact for this brand's supplier. `null` when no record is on file, or when the request is not authenticated with an API key (this field is only populated for API-key-authenticated callers).

company_name.description: Legal/company name of the responsible person.

email.description: Contact email of the responsible person.

address.description: Postal address of the responsible person.

responsible_person.description: The brand's responsible person in the EU, for a brand based outside the EU. API-key callers only, like `gpsr`; `null` otherwise or when not on file.

return_policy.description: The brand's returns. API-key callers only; `null` otherwise.

dispatch_days.description: The brand's default business days from order to dispatch (a product may override it). API-key callers only; `null` otherwise or when not recorded.

media_rights.description: How shops may use the brand's photos. API-key callers only.

has_gtins.description: Whether the brand's products carry GTINs at all. API-key callers only.

channels.description: Where the brand allows its products to be sold, per channel (amazon, ebay, etsy, bol, zalando, tiktok_shop, own_store); a channel left out is unknown. API-key callers only.

private_label.description: Whether the brand makes private-label versions. API-key callers only.

ShippingPrice.description: A single origin→destination shipping rate lane.

origin_iso_code.description: ISO-2 origin country code (the brand's shipping origin).

price.description: Shipping price for this lane in EUR. `null` when no rate is defined for the destination, OR when the caller is not API-key-authenticated (login-gated like product pricing — see the response's `meta.pricing`).

delivery_days.description: Business days in transit on this lane, after dispatch; `null` while not recorded.

ShippingPriceList.description: A brand's shipping price list. The `name` is a coverage tag (e.g. "EU", "EU · UK · USA"). `shipping_prices` holds one rate per origin→destination lane.

name.description: Coverage tag for the list (e.g. "EU", "EU · UK · USA").

per_item.description: True when the brand has at least one public product on this list that ships per item (large/extra-large size class), so shipping is charged per unit rather than once per order.

PricingMeta.description: Present in `meta` on every price-bearing response (products, product search, product detail, brand shipping price-lists). Tells you whether wholesale prices were included and, when withheld, how to unlock them. Lets you distinguish "no price on file" (a real `null` field) from "price withheld — authenticate" (this envelope, `included: false`).

authenticated.description: Whether the request carried a valid API key.

included.description: Whether wholesale prices were included in this response. `false` means every price field is `null` because the caller is unauthenticated. `true` means prices are included — though an individual field may still be a genuine `null` (e.g. no sale price, or no rate for a shipping lane).

reason.description: Why pricing was withheld. Only present when `included` is false.

message.description: Human-readable explanation and how to authenticate. Only present when `included` is false.

ImportListItem.description:
A product staged in the user's import list. `id` is the upstream
Hertwill catalog product id — pass it as `product_id` to
sync_products / get_sync_jobs. `product_id` is the storefront-side
import-list record id (internal bookkeeping; no public endpoint
accepts it). `status` is the sync lifecycle state for this item.

id.description: Upstream Hertwill catalog product id. This is the value to send as `product_id` to POST /v1/sync/products and GET /v1/sync/jobs/{productId}.

product_id.description: Storefront-side import-list record id (internal bookkeeping — NOT accepted by the sync endpoints; use `id` there).

gtin.description: GTIN (EAN/UPC barcode) of a product WITHOUT variations. `null` when unknown, and always `null` for a variable product — its barcodes live on `variations[].gtin`.

price.description: Wholesale Price in EUR (excl. VAT) — what the merchant pays Hertwill for the product.

sale_price.description: Optional temporary sale price (EUR, excl. VAT). When set and lower than `price`, it is the effective wholesale price charged.

default_store_markup.description: The merchant's ABSOLUTE selling price for this product in the store currency — not a markup multiplier or percentage.

variations.description: This store's import-list variation records. Each entry pairs the catalog variation id (`id` — the same value as `variations[].id` in GET /v1/products/{id}) with its import-list record id (`dropship_id`). POST /v1/sync/products requires BOTH values per variation. The complete PAIRING appears only here and in the POST /v1/import-list/products `variations` array (its `variation_ids` field carries unpaired record ids for freshly-inserted rows only), and it is NOT positional — always read it, never infer it. Empty for simple products. Note this endpoint's default `status=not-synced` filter — pass an explicit `status` to find already-synced products.

ImportListVariation.description: One import-list variation record: the (catalog variation id, import-list record id) pair that POST /v1/sync/products requires in `variations[]`. `sku` and `gtin` are included so the mapping can be verified independently.

id.description: Catalog variation id — matches `variations[].id` in GET /v1/products/{id}. Send as `variations[].id` when syncing.

dropship_id.description: Import-list record id for this variation in YOUR store. Send as `variations[].dropship_id` when syncing. Its pairing with `id` is not derivable from any other field — always read the pair from a `variations` array.

sku.description: The variation's SKU, for verifying the mapping.

gtin.description: GTIN (EAN/UPC barcode) of this variation; `null` when unknown.

422.description: Validation error (invalid email, password too short, missing fields)

post.description:
Returns a JWT token and refresh token. Use the JWT token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
to create API keys via `/v1/api-keys`.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token (use to get a new JWT)

422.description: Validation error (invalid email format, missing password)

get.description:
List products with faceted filtering, sorting, and pagination.
Note: variations are not included in list responses. Use GET /v1/products/{id} to get full product details with variations.

parameters.name: ships_to
parameters.description: Only products that can be sold to this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, matched against `sellable_countries`).

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated attribute values to filter by

facets.description: Counts per value for brand, collection, category, shipping_regions, sellable_countries, attributes, attribute_values and stock_status, within the current filters.

pricing.message: price and sale_price are null because wholesale pricing is available only to authenticated callers. Send a valid API key as `Authorization: Bearer hw_live_...` to receive prices.

Supports all the same filters as the browse endpoint.
Note: variations are not included in search results. Use GET /v1/products/{id} to get full product details with variations.

get.summary: Get category by ID or slug

get.description: List all brands, including their marketing material links (`logo`, `cover`, `marketing_assets_url`) and shipping origin country.
Retrieve a single brand, including its marketing material links (`logo`, `cover`, `marketing_assets_url`) and shipping origin country.

get.summary: Get a brand's shipping price lists
get.description: Returns the brand's shipping price lists (coverage tag + per origin→destination rate), same as the storefront. Use these rates to estimate delivery costs to your customers before importing a brand's products.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters the list to one status slice per call. When omitted, defaults to `not-synced` — products not yet synced to your store. Already-synced products are therefore absent from the default response; request them with `status=synced`. The `synced` and `not-synced` slices are exact complements, so the two together cover the complete import list.

post.description: Add one or more products to your store's import list. Max 50 products per request.

variation_ids.description: Record ids of variation rows CREATED by this call only (rows that already existed are omitted) — use `variations` for the complete, paired set.

variations.description: ALL of this store's import-list variation records for the product (present on `added` and `already_exists`), pairing each catalog variation id with its `dropship_id` for POST /v1/sync/products. The pairing is NOT positional — never infer it from array order.

422.description: Invalid request body (product_ids must be a non-empty array of integers, max 50)

404.description: Product not found in import list

post.description:
Trigger sync of a product from your import list to your connected store (Shopify/WooCommerce).
The product must already be in your import list.

**Prerequisites:**
- Your store must have a Shopify or WooCommerce integration connected. Set one up at [hertwill.com/account/integration](https://hertwill.com/account/integration).
- Your store must not have reached its product sync capacity. If you hit the limit, upgrade your plan at [hertwill.com/account/plans](https://hertwill.com/account/plans).

product_id.description: Catalog product id — the `id` field of an ImportListItem (NOT its `product_id` record id).

default_store_markup.description: Your ABSOLUTE selling price for the product in your store's currency (e.g. 24.99) — NOT a markup multiplier or percentage. A value below the wholesale `price` is rejected with 422 PRICE_BELOW_COST (a below-cost price almost always means a multiplier like 1.5 was sent where a price belongs).

variations.description: Required for products with variants — one entry per variant to publish. Read the (id, dropship_id) pairs from the `variations` array on GET /v1/import-list or POST /v1/import-list/products; the pairing is NOT positional, and a mismatched pair is rejected with 422.

id.description: Catalog variation id (`variations[].id` on the catalog product).

dropship_id.description: Import-list record id of the variation — the `dropship_id` paired with this `id` in the import-list `variations` array. Must match; a wrong pair returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

default_store_markup.description: Absolute selling price for this variation (same semantics as the top-level field).

403.description: Sync not allowed — store has reached its product sync limit. Upgrade your plan at hertwill.com/account/plans.

404.description: Product not found, or product not in import list — add it via POST /v1/import-list/products first.

422.description:
Validation error. Possible causes:
- No store platform connected — connect at hertwill.com/account/integration.
- Variations are required but not provided (or provided as an empty
  array) for a product with variants.
- PRICE_BELOW_COST: a `default_store_markup` (selling price) is below the
  product's wholesale `price`. The field is an absolute price, not a
  markup multiplier — send e.g. 24.99, not 1.5.
- A `variations[].id` does not belong to the product — use the catalog
  product's `variations[].id`.
- A `variations[].dropship_id` does not match the import-list record
  for that variation, or no import-list record exists for it — read
  the pairs from the `variations` array on
  POST /v1/import-list/products (idempotent; re-adding returns the
  pairs and re-creates any missing variation records).

502.description:
The sync could not be queued (transient infrastructure failure). The capacity
slot was released — retry the request. Re-submitting a product that is already
queued or syncing is safe and idempotent (returns 202 "Sync already in progress").

get.description: Returns the store-level sync health (healthy / degraded / disabled), per-status counts, and the failing-product subset (each carrying its derived error_class). Scope is always the authenticated API key's store; any client-supplied store_id is ignored. The response exposes only contract-safe derived fields — never the raw error payload or internal columns.
Returns products by sync status. Omit the status parameter to return all. Use GET /v1/sync/jobs/{productId} to check a specific product.

get.summary: Get sync status for a product

post.description:
Create a new store-scoped API key. Requires JWT authentication (login first).
The raw key is returned only once — store it securely.

store_id.description: Store to scope this key to

201.description: API key created (raw key shown only once)

key.description: The full API key (shown only once)

401.description: Not authenticated — login first via POST /v1/auth/login

403.description: You do not have access to this store

422.description: Invalid request body (name required, store_id must be a positive integer)

get.description: List all API keys for your stores. Secrets are masked (only prefix shown).
